request.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a new standalone Kalistar narrative fantasy painting of Kainé from NieR Replicant, vertical 4:5, for an existing card art window (no card frame). First reference defines ONLY recognizability and equipment: silver hair with tiny side braid and white Lunar Tear flower, pale blue opaque battle dress with black trim, bandages on her LEFT arm and LEFT leg, two separate steel swords whose backs have large regular triangular serrations. Do not use the reference's anime drawing style, text, pose, or exaggerated proportions. References2 Momo and3 Kaylis are the REQUIRED brushwork/face/material style, detailed hand-painted narrative fantasy, natural facial planes, visible crisp broad brushstrokes, tactile worn materials, not smooth or anime. Depict a credible combat instant on a stone ledge outside the Aerie: she has just stepped in front of someone threatened, feet securely braced, upper body angled toward an offscreen danger, jaw clenched, fierce furious protective eyes, wind pulls her silver bangs. One serrated sword is held diagonally forward, other low across her opposite side, BOTH sword hilts clearly gripped one in each hand, both straight blades visible in full, neither intersecting her body. An expressive determined woman in action, no fashion pose, no sexual framing or focus on chest or thighs. Keep dress opaque with a practical blue underskirt. Pale grey canyon and two small timber houses connected by a rope bridge far behind, plenty of open sky; recognizable Aerie atmosphere without overcrowding. Cool morninglight and muted warm highlights on the blade edges. Entire silhouette plus generous head and sword clearance, face/hands in middle60%width. Anatomy two arms twolegs, coherent grounded stance. No gore, typography, logos, watermark, symbols or UI.

review: Reviewed two separate straight serrated swords, left-side bandages, grounded stance, non-suggestive combat framing. Card crop must preserve weapon ends where possible.
